remarks:
Welcome to this beautifully maintained, single owner Colonial home, nestled in the desirable Windsor Ridge Neighborhood! Offering 3 bedrooms PLUS a versatile Loft Area, this home combines comfortable living spaces with impressive energy-efficient features, including a geothermal heating system and solar panels enhancement for electrical efficiency.

Enter into the 2-story foyer to the inviting living room, featuring a cozy gas fireplace, creating the perfect space to relax or entertain. The large eat-in kitchen is bathed in natural lighting and flows seamlessly into the dining area, where picturesque views of the backyard and surrounding green space can be enjoyed year-round.

The first floor is also home to a Laundry Room/Mudroom offering additional laundry hookups. All First Floor Doors are wheelchair accessible.

The spacious First Floor Primary Bedroom provides a wonderful retreat, complete with Walk-In Closet and En Suite Bath. Upstairs, the two additional Bedrooms plus loft area provide Flexibility for Guest Spaces, a Home Office, Hobby Space or whatever you can imagine.

Outside, the beautifully manicured lawn and gardens create a peaceful setting and enhance the home's curb appeal. The Covered Back Porch is the perfect setting for your Morning Coffee or Evening Relaxation.

The Attached 24 x 24 Garage has an Extra-Tall Door to accommodate larger vehicles as well as one of the four water spigots.. The Full Basement offers abundant storage as well as the mechanics for the Geothermal Heating System and Solar Electric Power, a Sump Pump with water back-up, a Water Softener System and Recirculation Pump on the hot water tank to provide almost instantaneous hot water. 

This Amazing Home is Truly Move In Ready!

Sellers will accept Escalation Clauses.
